decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component sprayer extends the firm's core coating know-how into a protective-coating niche, its market prospects are still uncertain after only one year, and keeping it costs little, so the option is worth holding.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established offer, has its own page signalling commitment, and costs little to carry, so the option should be kept.
The transfer pump builds on existing pump platforms with low carrying cost, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized, so it is kept.
Fire protection flow monitoring fits the firm's push toward digitalized, monitored processes, is featured on its own page, and remains an uncertain but cheap option worth keeping.
